Control_Question: Has the organisation assigned responsibility for data protection governance?
Expected_Evidence: DPO appointment or data protection lead terms of reference
Recommendation: Appoint data protection lead/DPO where required and define responsibilities

Control_Question: Is data protection risk reviewed by senior management?
Expected_Evidence: Management meeting minutes risk dashboard
Recommendation: Add data protection and cyber risk as standing agenda items

Control_Question: Are policies reviewed at least annually?
Expected_Evidence: Policy register version history approvals
Recommendation: Create policy review calendar and approval workflow

Control_Question: Does a Record of Processing Activities exist?
Expected_Evidence: ROPA document system inventory data map
Recommendation: Create ROPA covering residents staff suppliers and CCTV

Control_Question: Is lawful basis recorded for each processing activity?
Expected_Evidence: ROPA lawful basis column privacy notice mapping
Recommendation: Map Article 6 lawful basis and Article 9 condition

Control_Question: Is health and care data classified as special category data?
Expected_Evidence: Data classification standard care record access policy
Recommendation: Define classification and handling rules for health/care data

Control_Question: Are access controls role-based for care records?
Expected_Evidence: User access matrix access review report
Recommendation: Introduce quarterly access reviews and leaver checks

Control_Question: Are privacy notices clear and available to service users and families?
Expected_Evidence: Service user privacy notice website notice welcome pack
Recommendation: Update privacy notices using layered clear language

Control_Question: Does the staff privacy notice cover HR payroll DBS and monitoring?
Expected_Evidence: Staff privacy notice employee handbook
Recommendation: Refresh staff notice and issue acknowledgement

Control_Question: Is there a documented SAR process?
Expected_Evidence: SAR procedure SAR log response templates
Recommendation: Create SAR workflow and log with due dates

Control_Question: Are staff trained to recognise rights requests?
Expected_Evidence: Training records induction pack
Recommendation: Include rights requests in annual training

Control_Question: Is DPIA screening performed before new systems or high-risk processing?
Expected_Evidence: DPIA screening forms project checklist
Recommendation: Introduce DPIA screening for projects suppliers CCTV and monitoring

Control_Question: Is there a DPIA register?
Expected_Evidence: DPIA register completed DPIAs action tracker
Recommendation: Create DPIA register and review outstanding mitigations

Control_Question: Are regular sharing partners documented?
Expected_Evidence: Data sharing map partner list
Recommendation: Map sharing with local authorities NHS GP pharmacy emergency services suppliers

Control_Question: Are data sharing agreements in place where appropriate?
Expected_Evidence: Data sharing agreements MoUs contracts
Recommendation: Create or review agreements for controller-controller sharing

Control_Question: Are processor contracts reviewed for UK GDPR clauses?
Expected_Evidence: Supplier contracts DPA clauses due diligence checklist
Recommendation: Review processor clauses security requirements and deletion terms

Control_Question: Is supplier due diligence performed before onboarding?
Expected_Evidence: Supplier risk assessment security questionnaire
Recommendation: Use supplier due diligence checklist before procurement

Control_Question: Is MFA enabled on email cloud and remote access?
Expected_Evidence: MFA reports identity provider screenshots
Recommendation: Enable MFA for all privileged and remote access accounts

Control_Question: Are devices encrypted and protected by endpoint security?
Expected_Evidence: Device encryption report EDR/AV dashboard
Recommendation: Implement device encryption endpoint protection and device inventory

Control_Question: Is there an asset inventory for systems and devices?
Expected_Evidence: Asset register CMDB scan report
Recommendation: Create asset inventory with ownership and criticality

Control_Question: Are vulnerabilities scanned and remediated to SLA?
Expected_Evidence: Vulnerability scan reports patch SLA dashboard
Recommendation: Define monthly scans and SLA for critical/high findings

Control_Question: Is there a breach response process?
Expected_Evidence: Incident response procedure breach log
Recommendation: Create breach checklist and ICO reporting decision log

Control_Question: Are incidents reviewed for lessons learned?
Expected_Evidence: Post incident review actions
Recommendation: Add lessons learned actions to risk register

Control_Question: Is there a retention schedule for service user staff and supplier records?
Expected_Evidence: Retention schedule disposal log
Recommendation: Define retention periods and disposal approval process

Control_Question: Are paper and digital records securely destroyed?
Expected_Evidence: Shredding certificate deletion logs
Recommendation: Maintain disposal evidence and secure destruction contracts

Control_Question: Does the care provider have a documented minimum secure office network baseline?
Expected_Evidence: Network diagram firewall configuration standard router/switch hardening checklist Wi-Fi configuration screenshots
Gap: No documented baseline for office network security
Recommendation: Define a minimum office network baseline covering firewall, secure Wi-Fi, segmentation, secure DNS, admin access and logging

Control_Question: Is a business-grade firewall or securely configured router protecting the internet connection?
Expected_Evidence: Firewall asset record rulebase export configuration backup firmware version change log
Gap: Firewall presence or configuration not evidenced
Recommendation: Implement and document a managed firewall/router with default-deny inbound rules, restricted admin access, current firmware and regular rule review

Control_Question: Are care systems separated from guest Wi-Fi, personal devices and non-business networks?
Expected_Evidence: VLAN/Wi-Fi SSID design DHCP scopes firewall policies network diagram guest Wi-Fi configuration
Gap: No clear network separation between business and guest/personal traffic
Recommendation: Separate business systems, guest Wi-Fi and unmanaged devices using VLANs/SSIDs and firewall rules

Control_Question: Are all laptops, desktops and servers protected by supported antivirus or EDR?
Expected_Evidence: AV/EDR console device coverage report policy screenshot malware alert dashboard exception register
Recommendation: Deploy centrally managed antivirus/EDR to all endpoints and review alerts and coverage weekly

Control_Question: Are endpoint security policies configured for real-time protection, automatic updates and removable media controls?
Expected_Evidence: Endpoint policy configuration update status USB/removable media policy exception approval log
Gap: Endpoint policies may not enforce real-time protection or device control
Recommendation: Enforce real-time protection, automatic definition updates, controlled removable media use and documented exceptions

Control_Question: Is personal and care data backed up according to documented frequency, retention and ownership requirements?
Expected_Evidence: Backup policy backup schedule job reports retention settings data owner approval
Gap: Backup frequency, retention or ownership not documented
Recommendation: Define backup scope, frequency, retention periods and responsible owners for care records, finance, HR and operational systems

Control_Question: Are backup recovery tests performed regularly and evidenced?
Expected_Evidence: Restore test log recovery screenshots test results RTO/RPO report lessons learned actions
Gap: Backups exist but recovery has not been tested
Recommendation: Perform documented restore tests at least quarterly for critical systems and record success, failures and corrective actions

Control_Question: Are backups protected from ransomware through offline, immutable or separately secured backup controls?
Expected_Evidence: Immutable backup setting offline copy evidence separate admin account access control backup MFA screenshot
Gap: Backups could be modified or deleted by compromised production accounts
Recommendation: Use immutable/offline backups, separate backup admin accounts, MFA and restricted deletion rights

Control_Question: Are backup transfers and system-to-system data transmissions encrypted in transit?
Expected_Evidence: Backup transport configuration TLS/VPN evidence cloud backup encryption settings supplier confirmation
Gap: Encryption of backup or data transmission paths not evidenced
Recommendation: Require encrypted transmission for backups and data sharing using TLS, VPN or equivalent secure protocols

Control_Question: Are backups and portable media containing personal data encrypted at rest?
Expected_Evidence: Encryption policy backup encryption setting BitLocker/FileVault report removable media encryption evidence key management procedure
Gap: Backup storage or portable media encryption not evidenced
Recommendation: Encrypt backups, laptops, removable media and cloud storage containing personal or special category data, with controlled key management

Control_Question: Are network devices, firewalls, servers and endpoints patched within defined risk-based SLAs?
Expected_Evidence: Patch policy patch compliance dashboard firewall/router firmware report exception register
Gap: Patch SLAs for infrastructure and endpoints not evidenced
Recommendation: Define patch SLAs for critical/high vulnerabilities and track exceptions until remediation
